messages:
sam: Quick sync  scheduling staggered deploy tonight 23:30 UTC. Order: runtime -> api -> router -> console. Need pins, prehooks, rollback owners.
toni: I'll own runtime. Plan: kernel selection tweak + batching behind flag. Pin runtime@7cf2.
devsre: Quiet window 23:00-00:30 UTC; freeze autoscaler during deploy.
sam: @toni expose a warm-check endpoint that only returns ready after KV/cache warm. deploy-bot will gate traffic.
toni: Will add `/health?cache=ready` and env RUNTIME_BATCH_MODE=delayed.
natacha: I'll own API. No contract change; add header X-Service-Version for tracing. Pin api:v3.2.1.
bryan: Router will run binary smoke. Pin router:sha-4b2b.
ux-support: Console on standby; no code change but support toggle ready.
sam: Canary plan 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100%. Hold times 10/10/15. Auto-rollback if 5xx > 0.75% for 10m OR p50 reg > 40ms for 5m.
devsre: Pre-deploy: kubectl annotate ns infra freeze=true. Also prep alerts and rollback playbook.
toni: runtime flag runtime.warm=false initially; deploy-bot flips post-warm.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Planned wave WARMUP_20260315_2330Z targets runtime:runtime@7cf2, api:api:v3.2.1, router:router:sha-4b2b, console:unchanged. Prehooks: router-smoke, runtime-warmcheck. Canary progression 5/25/75/100.
bryan: smoke script added: `./smoke-router.sh --endpoint https://router-smoke/health` returns 0 if OK.
natacha: API tag pushed and header injection enabled in prod config.
toni: runtime image pushed; warm-check local OK.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Running prehooks... router-smoke OK; runtime-warmcheck PENDING.
toni: warmcheck now OK.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: runtime-warmcheck OK. Initiating 5% canary.
bryan: seeing 5% traffic. smoke clear.
natacha: traces show header. p50 +5ms.
devsre: logs-sanity passed, no error spikes. Proceed to 25%.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: increased to 25%.
toni: transient mem blip but within limits. batching queue stable.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: increased to 75% after hold.
bryan: 75% stable. Holding 15m.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: ramp to 100% complete. Posthooks perf-smoke OK, logs-sanity OK.
sam: Confirm pins for audit: runtime=runtime@7cf2, api=api:v3.2.1, router=router:sha-4b2b, console=unchanged.
toni: Confirmed.
natacha: Confirmed.
bryan: Confirmed.
devsre: Re-enabled autoscaler at 00:40 UTC. No rollback needed.
ux-support: Support blurb posted. Closing thread and filing release note with perf numbers. Thanks all :rocket:
